_readme: Restriction overrides for specific OSM way IDs, merged into the graph at load time. Each entry below is a REAL, NAMED underpass/tunnel found in the Busan road data that currently has NO maxheight/maxweight tag in OSM - meaning the graph currently treats it as unrestricted, which is very likely wrong for a physical underpass. The 'maxheight' values are PLACEHOLDERS (null) - go check the actual clearance via Kakao/Naver Roadview (links provided) or the physical posted sign, then fill in the real number and remove the 'TODO' note. Only entries with an actual value set will affect routing; null values are ignored.
